title: Translated rectifiable varifold structure
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} be an arbitrary set, and let V = v(M, θ) be a rectifiable n-varifold in U. That is, M ⊆ U is countably n-rectifiable and Hⁿ-null-measurable, and θ is positive on M, Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. measurable and Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U. Let x₀ ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ}. Then there is a rectifiable n-varifold W in {y : y + x₀ ∈ U} with carrier {y : y + x₀ ∈ M} and with multiplicity y ↦ θ(y + x₀) for every y.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (x₀ : Amb n ℓ), ∃ W : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun y => y + x₀) ⁻¹' U), W.carrier = (fun y => y + x₀) ⁻¹' V.carrier ∧ ∀ y, W.mult y = V.mult (y + x₀)
